VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The agent's self-report alone is insufficient to verify acceptance criteria satisfaction. While the agent claims "all 44 tests pass locally," there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test results, diffs, or artifacts) to corroborate this claim. The fix description (changing from IP-based to client ID-based keying) is plausible, but without verifiable proof of test passage or code review, the acceptance criteria cannot be confirmed as met.
